# KPI DRIVER

> KPI DRIVER is a real estate business operations platform built by investors for investors. Its CRM runs lead capture, acquisitions, nurture, dispositions, transaction coordination, contractors and vendors, and owned and rental properties, with KPI tracking across every pipeline and included access to a nine-tool AI Suite.

## Key facts
- Company: KPI DRIVER, LLC, Pembroke Pines, Florida, USA. Email: info@kpidriver.com
- Audience: real estate investors and their teams (acquisitions, dispositions, transaction coordination, property management)
- Offerings: (1) Enterprise Optimization Suite = CRM + AI Suite access. (2) Enterprise Optimization Suite + AI Agent.
- AI Suite access is included with no additional AI Suite subscription. Usage is optional and pay-as-you-go.
- The AI Agent is a separate, optional offering. It follows up with new and older leads by AI voice, SMS, email and iMessage within rules the client sets.
- AI Suite tools: AI Notes Taker, AI Sales Coach, AI Training Coach, AI Underwriting, AI Skiptracing, AI Data Enrichment, AI Dashboard, AI Insights, AI Projections.
- Nurture is backup for the acquisitions team: situational, timed and AI-tailored campaigns revive stalled leads and hand them back to acquisitions. All nurtures are in English and Spanish.
- Support is personal: every client has a dedicated channel with the team. No chatbots and no ticket queue.
- Pricing is discussed on a discovery call.

## Guides
- [Managing Owned and Rental Properties in the Same System as Your Deals](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/rental-portfolio-management-system): When you keep a property, the work does not end at closing. This guide covers what to track for owned and rental properties and why it belongs alongside your acquisition data.
- [Dispositions From Contract to Buyer: A Working Guide](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/dispositions-guide-real-estate-investors): Dispositions turns a signed contract into a committed buyer. This guide covers the buyers list, marketing the deal, handling offers and the handoff to transaction coordination.
- [The Acquisition Manager Playbook: From First Call to Signed Contract](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/acquisition-manager-playbook): A working guide to the acquisition manager role: how to structure the first call, qualify motivation, present an offer and keep the deal moving to a signed contract.
- [The Systems That Scale Real Estate Investing Businesses](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/systems-that-scale-real-estate-investing): Scaling a real estate investing business isn’t about working harder—it’s about building the right systems. Learn the exact systems top investors use to manage leads, automate follow-ups, track deals, and scale consistently.
- [How to Track Real Estate Marketing ROI](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/real-estate-marketing-roi): Most real estate investors don’t know which marketing channels actually make them money. This guide breaks down how to track real estate marketing ROI, measure cost per deal, and eliminate wasted spend so you can scale profitably.
- [How Real Estate Investors Automate Their Entire Business](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/real-estate-automation-system-investors): Automation is no longer optional in real estate investing. This guide shows how top investors automate lead response, follow-ups, scheduling, and deal tracking to eliminate missed opportunities, increase conversions, and scale efficiently.
- [The Only Real Estate KPIs That Actually Matter](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/real-estate-kpis-that-matter): Most investors track activity—but not performance. This guide breaks down the only real estate KPIs that actually matter, including conversion rates, cost per deal, and pipeline metrics, so you can identify bottlenecks, increase profitability, and scale with precision.
- [The Ultimate Guide to Real Estate CRMs for Investors](https://www.kpidriver.com/post/best-real-estate-crm-for-investors): Most real estate CRMs are built for agents—not investors. In this guide, discover what actually makes a CRM effective for investors, including automation, KPI tracking, and pipeline visibility, and how the right system can dramatically increase conversions and scalability.
